description: Flat metadata schema for individual bacterial metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) records from soil samples, capturing sample provenance, geographic context, binning workflow, software parameters, and genome quality metrics for comparative ecological and evolutionary analyses.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the MAG metadata record within the dataset.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier of the soil sample from which the MAG was derived.

mag_id.descr: Unique identifier of the metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) or bin/binning result.

project_id.descr: Optional project or study identifier linking the record to a larger sequencing effort.

collection_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected (ISO 8601 format, e.g., YYYY-MM-DD).

latitude.descr: Sampling latitude in decimal degrees; positive north, negative south.

longitude.descr: Sampling longitude in decimal degrees; positive east, negative west.

elevation_m.descr: Sampling elevation above sea level in meters.

country.descr: Country where the soil sample was collected.

region.descr: Administrative region, province, state, or comparable geographic area.

site_name.descr: Local site name or field location label.

habitat_type.descr: Broad habitat category of the soil environment, such as forest, grassland, agricultural, desert, tundra, or urban.

soil_type.descr: Soil classification or descriptive soil type, if available.

soil_ph.descr: Measured soil pH at the sampling site.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percent weight/volume or equivalent study-defined percent measure.

soil_organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content as percent, if measured.

temperature_c.descr: Ambient or soil temperature in degrees Celsius at collection or measurement time.

salinity.descr: Soil salinity or electrical conductivity metric as reported by the study; units should be specified in accompanying documentation if not standard.

sample_depth_cm.descr: Depth of soil sampling in centimeters below surface.

metagenome_assembly_id.descr: Identifier of the metagenome assembly used as input for binning.

contig_set_id.descr: Identifier for the contig set or assembly version used in MAG reconstruction.

assembly_software.descr: Name of the assembler used to generate contigs prior to binning, e.g., MEGAHIT, metaSPAdes, IDBA-UD.

assembly_software_version.descr: Version of the assembly software used.

binning_algorithm.descr: Primary binning algorithm used to generate the MAG, e.g., MetaBAT2, MaxBin2, CONCOCT, VAMB, SemiBin.

binning_strategy.descr: Binning strategy description, such as single-method, multi-method consensus, differential coverage, or manual refinement.

binning_software.descr: Software package used for binning or bin refinement; may be the same as the binning algorithm or a workflow tool.

binning_software_version.descr: Version of the binning software used.

binning_parameters.descr: Text summary of key binning parameters used, including thresholds, cluster settings, k-mer settings, or coverage cutoffs.

coverage_input_type.descr: Type of coverage information used for binning, such as single-sample coverage, multi-sample differential coverage, or coverage normalization approach.

read_mapping_software.descr: Software used to map reads to assemblies for coverage estimation, if applicable.

read_mapping_software_version.descr: Version of the read mapping software used.

manual_refinement_performed.descr: Whether manual curation or refinement of bins was performed after automated binning.

dereplication_performed.descr: Whether MAG dereplication was performed to remove redundant bins.

checkm_software.descr: Software used to assess MAG quality, typically CheckM or CheckM2.

checkm_version.descr: Version of the MAG quality assessment software.

completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness as a percentage from quality assessment tools.

contamination_percent.descr: Estimated genome contamination as a percentage from quality assessment tools.

strain_heterogeneity_percent.descr: Estimated strain heterogeneity or microdiversity metric as a percentage, if reported.

completeness_method.descr: Method or model used to estimate completeness, if different from the software name.

contamination_method.descr: Method or model used to estimate contamination, if different from the software name.

genome_quality_category.descr: Quality class of the MAG, such as high-quality, medium-quality, low-quality, or study-defined category.

mag_size_bp.descr: Total assembled MAG size in base pairs.

num_contigs.descr: Number of contigs/scaffolds in the MAG.

n50_bp.descr: N50 of the MAG assembly in base pairs.

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the MAG as a percentage.

coverage_mean.descr: Mean read coverage depth across the MAG, if calculated.

coverage_median.descr: Median read coverage depth across the MAG, if calculated.

coding_density_percent.descr: Percentage of the MAG sequence predicted to be coding, if available.

marker_genes_found.descr: Number of single-copy marker genes detected during quality assessment.

marker_genes_expected.descr: Expected number of marker genes for the lineage or quality assessment model.

taxonomy_domain.descr: Taxonomic domain assignment, expected to be Bacteria for this dataset but stored explicitly for interoperability.

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic assignment, such as GTDB-Tk, Kraken2, CAT/BAT, or marker-gene based classification.

taxonomic_reference_db.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic assignment, including version or release if known.

environmental_adaptation_notes.descr: Short free-text description of notable adaptation-related features or ecological context relevant to this MAG.

functional_annotation_software.descr: Software used for functional annotation of the MAG, if performed.

functional_annotation_database.descr: Reference database used for functional annotation, such as KEGG, eggNOG, PFAM, or COG.

contig_taxonomy_conflict_flag.descr: Whether contig- or bin-level taxonomy showed notable conflict or mixed assignment suggesting potential chimerism.

chimera_suspected.descr: Whether the MAG was flagged as potentially chimeric during QC or refinement.

release_status.descr: Availability status of the MAG, such as public, embargoed, or internal.

accession_number.descr: Public database accession for the MAG, if deposited (for example in NCBI GenBank, ENA, or DDBJ).
